answer.main_body: drum-shaped clock head on pillar with stone base
answer.evidence: The top of the drum-shaped clock head clearly shows its foreshortened circular top surface across rows 1 to 5, and the stone base similarly shows a foreshortened top surface around rows 31-36.

answer.main_body: street clock pillar with drum-shaped clock head, central post, and cylindrical stone base
answer.evidence: The top surface of the drum-shaped clock head is clearly depicted with foreshortening across rows 1-5 (5 rows tall), and the stone base also shows a distinct elliptical top plane (rows 31-36).

answer.main_body: drum-shaped street clock head on a pillar with a stone base
answer.evidence: The top drum head clearly shows a foreshortened top surface across rows 1-5, and the stone base similarly shows a visible top surface across rows 32-36.

answer.main_body: street pillar clock (drum-shaped clock head and round stone base)
answer.evidence: The drum-shaped clock head has a clearly visible elliptical top surface spanning rows 1-5, with the front face (and clock dial) below it (rows 6-15). The round base also displays an elliptical top surface (rows 31-36).
